prompt: Step 1 counts the orders of each registered customer at each store; step 2 takes the highest of those counts. Guest orders have a missing customer_id and do not count. Which query writes these two steps with a CTE (WITH) and returns that highest count, in one column, max_orders?

options.text:
WITH customer_store AS (
  -- one row per customer and store
  SELECT customer_id, store_id, COUNT(*) AS n_orders
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY customer_id, store_id
)
SELECT MAX(n_orders) AS max_orders
FROM customer_store

WITH customer_store AS (
  -- one row per registered customer
  SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS n_orders
  FROM orders
  WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT MAX(n_orders) AS max_orders
FROM customer_store

WITH customer_store AS (
  -- one row per registered customer and store
  SELECT customer_id, store_id, COUNT(*) AS n_orders
  FROM orders
  WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY customer_id, store_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS max_orders
FROM customer_store
